subject: Financial Management and Strategic Management
paper_name: Paper-6: Financial Management and Strategic Management
question_text:
8.  
The cost of equity capital is all of the following except:  
(A)  
the minimum rate that a firm should earn on the equity-financed part of an 
investment.  
(B)  
a return on the equity-financed portion of an investment that, at worst, leaves the 
market price of the stock unchanged.  
(C)  
by far the most difficult component cost to estimate.  
(D)  
generally lower than the before-tax cost of debt.    
(1 Mark) 
 
 
5 
PART II – Descriptive Questions (35 Marks) 
Question No. 1 is compulsory. 
Attempt any two questions out of the remaining three questions.
suggested_answer: (D) Generally lower than the before-tax cost of debt. 3 PART II – Descriptive Questions
